Title: Q: Shadow Court Satyr with Shape Mastery

Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
Is it possible to put on a Satyr and then use the reaction version of
the card? It would be quite gosu to have Satyr untapped rest of the
game and cancel all S:CE from protean etc anyone plays :) I can't see
why this isn't possible reding card text.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You don't mention the name of the card, so hard to say.
The "subject:"'s purpose is to describe the body, not to supplant it.

No. Card text: "the basic ability". The reaction version is the
superior. Besides, he can only use combat versions in any case.

The Satyr can use the combat version to cancel a Form of Mist or
whatnot, though.

I do not grok "gosu", sorry.
